授業概要
この授業は、地球社会統合科学府の社会的多様性共存コースの国際コース「総合演習」のクラスである。社会科学における多様な視点、理論、方法論を身につけ、現代社会における多様性に関する課題を分析し、その解決策を探究することを目的としている。また、批判的思考を養い、社会生活の複雑性に対する理解を深め、文章作成およびプレゼンテーション能力を向上させることも目指す。参加者は自らの研究を発表し、意見交換を行い、互いにフィードバックを提供する。それにより、関連する議論を統合し、各自の研究課題を発展させ、適切な分析枠組みを選択・適用する力を身につける。
This student-centered seminar is part of the Social Diversity and Coexistence course in ISGS. Participants will present their research, exchange ideas, and provide feedback to their peers. Through this seminar, they will learn to synthesize relevant discussions, develop their individual research questions, and select and apply appropriate analytical frameworks.

全体の教育目標
This seminar aims to equip students with diverse perspectives, theories, and methodologies in the social sciences, enabling them to analyze and explore solutions to issues related to social, gender, sexual, ethnic, racial, and other forms of diversity. It also seeks to foster critical thinking, deepen understanding of the complexities of social life, and enhance writing and presentation skills.
個別の教育目標
1. To identify a subject and approach related to issues of social diversity and ultimately complete a thesis or academic paper.
2. To gain experience and enhance students' ability to read English academic materials, and present and discuss them in English.
授業計画
Assignments will be indicated in the class.
キーワード
sociology, cultural anthropology, human geography, and philosophy
授業の進め方
The presentation order will be decided in the first class. Seminars will be held every other week, with one student presenting in each session. Students are expected to attend all classes and provide feedback on their peers' presentations when they are not presenting.
※Make sure to come to the first class.
※※This class is for international students, and is held independently from 社会的多様性多様性コース総合演習.
